patch_list: Stops the game writing its debug log, which saves CPU time, mostly when offline. Only the arm64-v8a library is kept.
Removes the game's network access and turns off analytics and crash reports. Nothing the game needs is online once Offline mode is applied.

Events keep coming offline: once the event calendar the app came with is over, it starts again from the first event, and each event starts with its points and rewards reset. Only the arm64-v8a library is kept.

Lets the game start and play without network access, also on a first start: no privacy, sign-in, Play Games or cloud save pop-ups, and the profile, inbox and leaderboard buttons are hidden. The save stays on the device: the game no longer…
Removes the Halfbrick+ subscription pop-up that blocks the game, so it can be played offline. Only the arm64-v8a library is kept.
Removes the "rate this app" and review pop-ups. Only the arm64-v8a library is kept.
Removes the Halfbrick+ video at startup. Only the arm64-v8a library is kept.
